journey: Android app restart auth and ad-block regression

results.action: Install the updated debug APK without clearing application data
results.comment: Package update completed successfully and existing app data was preserved.

results.action: Verify that the authenticated My Page is visible before restart
results.comment: The account profile and three owned pairs were visible; no global ad-block modal covered the app.

results.action: Verify authentication and ad-block state after restart
results.comment: The before/after My Page screenshots had the same SHA-256 hash; the logged-in screen remained and no global ad-block modal appeared.
